name: libnexa-monorepo
description: LIBNEXA: Mobile Library Catalog and Borrowing Management System (NSUK)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/shared run build && npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
